per_task.task: finish the APAC cost center hierarchy mapping
subtasks: Gather current APAC cost center structures across all regional entities
Map legacy cost centers to the target S/4HANA global hierarchy
Verify hierarchy alignment with parallel ledger cutover requirements
Review proposed mapping with APAC regional finance leads for sign-off
Upload finalized cost center hierarchy mapping into the SAP system
per_task.comment: Every subtask is directly tied to the parent task, follows a logical end-to-end sequence (gather → map → verify → review → upload), each step is concrete and doable, together they fully complete the mapping exercise, and there is no meaningful overlap between steps.

per_task.task: send the new cost center codes to Daniel

Verify cost center codes against parallel ledger requirements
Format the cost center codes into a shareable document
Send the cost center codes to Daniel
per_task.comment: The subtasks are all relevant and cover the end-to-end flow well, but "Obtain the finalized APAC cost center mapping list" introduces a geographic assumption (APAC) not present in the parent task, and the final subtask is essentially a restatement of the parent task itself, slightly reducing non-redundancy.

per_task.task: diagnose the root cause of the bank statement upload test failure
subtasks: Review error logs and test failure output
Replicate bank statement upload failure in test environment
Verify APAC mapping rules and parallel ledger setup
Pinpoint root cause in data format or configuration
Document findings and recommended fix
per_task.comment: The subtasks are highly relevant and collectively cover the full diagnostic lifecycle end-to-end, though "Verify APAC mapping rules and parallel ledger setup" is somewhat domain-specific and assumptive (not all upload failures relate to APAC/ledger config), and "Pinpoint root cause" slightly overlaps with the earlier log review and replication steps rather than being a fully distinct action.

per_task.task: fix the MT940 parser config for multi-currency statements
subtasks: Review current MT940 parser configuration and error logs
Align multi-currency tag parsing with APAC mapping rules
Update parser configuration for multi-currency statement handling
Run test imports with sample multi-currency MT940 files
Validate statement postings in the parallel ledger
per_task.comment: The subtasks are all genuinely relevant and together cover the full fix cycle end-to-end (diagnose → align rules → update config → test → validate), though "Align multi-currency tag parsing with APAC mapping rules" partially overlaps with "Update parser configuration for multi-currency statement handling," and both actionability and distinctness could be sharpened by clarifying that the alignment step is analysis/design while the update step is the actual implementation change.

per_task.task: chase the vendor for a firm barcode firmware patch date
